authority: Existing autonomous project-lead mandate; source self-review, not independent approval
purpose: Resolve the six missing early510300cash payment dates before a continuous-account method can use actual cash timing. Earlier endpoint diagnostics needed distribution entitlement but did not certify payment dates. This does not alter or rerun those studies.

source_scope.PDF_selection: Six original distribution announcements, published before the corresponding ex date and in its civil month. Exactly one original per event; exclude reminders and corrections. Any ambiguity, truncation or mismatched date stops selection; no speculative URLs or retries.
source_scope.request_policy: Exclusive claim before each request; verifiedTLS; no redirect or retry; 30second read timeout;12MiBcap; retain all outcomes. No credentials or provider calls.
